November 1 | Application; application fee or fee waiver

- On the Cornell University questions, select "Yes, I am eligible for a fee waiver" when asked "Are you eligible for an application fee waiver?"

Cornell University Supplement

As part of your Common Application, you'll be asked to fill out the Cornell University supplement, which includes the college- or school-specific essay(s) you'll need to answer. Be sure to review the writing prompt(s) for the college or school you're applying to.
